jobs.description:
Support to “Quality Manager-Europe” in daily business:

 

• Coordinate the development of monthly and weekly Quality report
• Support meeting preparation and presentation development
• Follow up on Logistics
• Liaise with the regional Project & Sales Team in Brussels
• Coordination with Bosch Residents and with the Quality representatives from all Bosch Business Units delivering one of major automobile manufacturer
• New Projects Monitoring & Review follow-up
• Field Parts recovery and follow-up
• Daily Part Recovery observation

You are currently an engineering or international management student with very good computer skills (MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint).

Basic knowledge in SAP R/3 is appreciated. You have very good analytical and communication skills and the ability to work independently, using own initiation as well as a pro-active approach to the issues.

 

You are fluent in English.

• Guide clients during the complete process of a project (follow up from A till Z),  
• Assist clients with tax audits and tax claims,  
• Handle compliance services for individuals (also expatriates):salary splits, expat calculations,…  
• Prepare resident and non-resident income tax returns  
• Assist international companies with HR matters: employment, labour contracts, optimisation of salary packages etc.,   
• Provide clients with clear (written) advice by conducting research and making the necessary calculations,  
• Be in direct contact with clients, colleagues abroad and other partner organizations. 
  
• Master s degree in (Applied) Economic Sciences or Commercial Sciences or a degree in Law, or a degree in business management  
• A tax degree is a plus,  
• Specialization in Personal income tax for expats or salary split,  
• Fluent in Dutch/Flemish, English and French,  
• Ability to work autonomously and work as a team player with excellent project management skills,  
• Flexible, accurate and eager to learn,  
• Good communication and organizational skills,  
• Proactive and hands on mentality,  
• Adherence to the highest degree of professional standards and strict client confidentiality.

In this role, you will support a broad range of accounting activities, including invoice processing, bank bookings, reconciliations, monthly closing, reporting and audit support. You will work closely with internal stakeholders and contribute to improving accounting processes. Are you ready for the next step in your career? Don't hesitate to apply.

Your responsibilities:

• Process sales, purchase and general expense invoices in SAP.
• Perform daily bank bookings, reconciliations and account checks.
• Review and follow up on invoices, open items and DMS workflows.
• Process employee expense claims through SAP.
• Support monthly closing, reporting, accruals and reconciliations.
• Prepare documentation for audits and J-SOX requirements.
• Assist with fixed assets, stock counts and other accounting tasks.
• Support internal users with SAP and invoice-processing questions.
• Contribute to process improvements.
• Provide back-up support to the wider accounting team when needed.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• At least 2 years of relevant accounting experience.
• Good knowledge of accounting principles.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• Good MS Office/Excel skills.
• Accurate, organized and detail-oriented.
• Proactive, solution-oriented and a strong team player.
• Fluent in English and good knowledge of French and Dutch.

• Acting as financial partner to the business leaders in EMEA, with direct contact with the regional CFO and presentations for senior management  
• Building the monthly forecast, the annual plan and the long-range plan, with variance analysis against forecast, budget and prior year  
• Analyzing revenue, gross margin, product mix and customer profitability, and working with sales and product management on pricing and margin  
• Developing business cases and financial models for new products, investments and market expansion, with scenario analyses for management  
• Tracking daily sales against target, calculating and validating quarterly sales bonuses, and owning the budget for commercial investments and rebates      
Improving forecasting and reporting through automation & dashboards
  
You don't give the sales team numbers, you give them choices.

  
• Master's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business or a related field  
• 5 to 15 years of experience in finance or controlling  
• Fluent English plus French or Dutch; Trilingual = Plus  
• Experience in ERP and tools such as Power BI or Tableau

• Portfolio Development & Business Growth     
• Develop and expand the company's product portfolio within specialty chemicals.   
• Identify new products, suppliers and market opportunities based on customer needs and market developments.   
• Build business cases for new product groups and assess their commercial potential.   
• Leverage your existing industry network to establish new supplier relationships and unlock additional business opportunities.   
• Proactively identify opportunities to expand the company's market presence and generate additional revenue.      
• Strategic Procurement & Supplier Management     
• Develop and execute procurement strategies aligned with the company's growth ambitions.   
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with international suppliers.   
• Lead commercial negotiations on pricing, payment terms, delivery conditions and contractual agreements.   
• Monitor global raw material markets, pricing trends and supply risks.   
• Identify alternative suppliers and products to improve competitiveness and supply reliability.      
• Commercial & Financial Management     
• Work closely with Sales to identify customer needs and translate these into portfolio opportunities.   
• Monitor purchasing costs and market developments and translate these into competitive selling prices.   
• Set and review monthly sales price levels for different products.   
• Identify opportunities to improve gross margins and overall profitability.   
• Contribute to the development of new business through strong supplier and market relationships.      
• Operational & Supply Chain Management     
• Oversee purchasing activities and ensure timely replenishment of inventory.   
• Balance stock availability, customer service levels and working capital.   
• Monitor supplier lead times and delivery performance.   
• Support demand forecasting and inventory optimization.   
• Drive continuous improvement in procurement processes and reporting.     
  
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Chemistry or equivalent experience.  
• 5–10 years of experience in procurement, sourcing or portfolio management.  
• Strong experience in the chemical industry and an established network of contacts within this industry, with the ability to leverage these relationships to create new business opportunities.  
• Proven experience in international supplier management and commercial negotiations.  
• Strong strategic, commercial and analytical skills, with a good understanding of pricing, margins and inventory management.  
• Hands-on, entrepreneurial and proactive mindset, with the ability to work independently.  
• Fluent in English; Dutch and/or French are a plus.

An organization primarily funded by the government of Belgium, it supports scientific research across various disciplines, providing grants and fellowships to researchers and scholars. It plays a crucial role in advancing knowledge and innovation within the country, contributing to scientific progress on both national and international levels.

Jobomschrijving

Job Function

The hired individual will be attached to the International and Institutional Affairs Department – Mobility and Congress, primarily responsible for administrative management of the department.

Tasks

Administering the management of the department's email inquiries and secretarial tasks.

Processing various documents.

Providing administrative support to team members.

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators

Reviewing the content once it has been translated and integrating it into our CMS according to the production process

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in administration

Proficient written and spoken English (minimum B2 level)

Minimum 2 years of experience in administration

Excellent spelling and grammar

Ability to analyze and synthesize information

Organizational skills, attention to detail, dynamism, adaptability to priorities, and flexibility

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team

Proficiency in computer tools (MS Office)

Knowledge of the academic and research world

Manage the team’s annual calendar, integrating all Group and Entity deadlines.

Organize internal and external meetings, seminars, and events, handling logistics, participant coordination, and agenda preparation.

Collect necessary information for the manager’s activities and address specific issues as required.

Manage purchases, validate expenses, and oversee budget monitoring when delegated.

Facilitate communication within the assistants’ network, organizing regular meetings and ensuring smooth collaboration.

Provide hierarchical or functional management of assistants as needed.

Strong organizational and time management skills to handle schedules, priorities, and deadlines.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a high level of proficiency in English.

Proficiency in software and tools (e.g., Microsoft Office) for data and budget management.

Detail-oriented and proactive mindset to ensure accuracy and smooth operations.

Problem-solving and adaptability to address challenges effectively.

Team collaboration and leadership abilities to coordinate with colleagues and assistants.

jobs.occupation: (Junior) Inside Sales | German Market | Antwerp | On-site
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating within the food sector. With a family-business mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and strong growth ambitions, they offer a fast-paced environment where initiative and results are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

• Proactively identify and develop new business opportunities within the German market.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Manage the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals.
• Conduct commercial negotiations and follow up on sales opportunities.
• Expand the customer portfolio and strengthen market presence.
• Analyze sales performance and market trends.
• Report on sales activities and contribute to the overall sales strategy.

• Fluent in German and English, knowledge of Dutch or additional languages is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development, or a commercial role is a plus, but junior candidates with the right mindset are also welcome.
• Strong commercial acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
• A true go-getter with the drive to open new doors and create opportunities.
• Confident communicator with excellent relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to learn.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Affinity with the food industry is an advantage.
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
